description: Na₃ZnB₅O₁₀ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.57 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.77 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.61 Å. Zn is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-1.99 Å. There are five inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.33-1.41 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.34-1.41 Å. In the third B site, B is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.47 Å. In the fourth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.33-1.41 Å. In the fifth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.34-1.40 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Zn, and one B atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂ZnB tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Zn, and one B atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂ZnB tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Zn, and one B atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one B atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two B atoms.
